reviews.comment: Professor Stanev was great! He is extremely nice and laid back and was always willing to give good career advice. He graded very leniently and was understanding. Just show up and participate, and you'll do well. Definitely recommend him for any student!

He was a great professor. Great lectures, good homework, and a delightful class. You only go to class on Friday, not Tuesday. He wants you to watch the videos before Friday. I would if I were you. He likes participation, and you have projects/HW instead of tests. You don't have too many. Fairly easy class

This class is fantastic, and Professor Stanev is the perfect guy to teach it. Every lecture is fast-paced and super engaging. If you follow along in the lecture, you will have little homework. He grades attendance and participation, but it's easy to earn points by doing extra credit assignments and answering his questions. This is my favorite class

Prof Stanev is a solid prof when it comes to 210. Attendance is not mandatory, he records all lectures so they are very easy to look back over (I watched them on 2x speed). If you ask to meet with him outside of class, he is more than happy to do so. Sweet guy, and understanding professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class
